# Tables

A pipe table, with a default column and one of each alignment:

| Construct | Left                       | Center    | Right |
| --------- | :------------------------- | :-------: | ----: |
| emphasis  | *emphasis in a cell*       | plain     |     1 |
| code      | `inline code`              | a \| pipe |     2 |
| link      | [Typst](https://typst.app) | plain     |     3 |
| short row | three cells                | only      |
